# Data from Treasury Bulletin June 1960, Page 71

# January 1960
jan_total_collections = 4807819
jan_unemployment_ins = 26461

# March 1960

mar_unemployment_ins = 20174

# Arc elasticity (midpoint formula)
# E = ((Q2 - Q1) / ((Q2 + Q1)/2)) / ((P2 - P1) / ((P2 + P1)/2))

# Percentage change in total collections

Q2 = mar_total_collections
pct_change_collections = (Q2 - Q1) / ((Q2 + Q1) / 2) * 100

# Percentage change in unemployment insurance contributions  
P1 = jan_unemployment_ins
P2 = mar_unemployment_ins
pct_change_unemployment = (P2 - P1) / ((P2 + P1) / 2) * 100

# Arc elasticity
arc_elasticity = pct_change_collections / pct_change_unemployment

print(f"January 1960:")
print(f"  Total Collections: {Q1:,} (thousands)")
print(f"  Unemployment Insurance: {P1:,} (thousands)")
print()
print(f"March 1960:")
print(f"  Total Collections: {Q2:,} (thousands)")
print(f"  Unemployment Insurance: {P2:,} (thousands)")
print()
print(f"Percentage change in Total Collections: {pct_change_collections:.4f}%")
print(f"Percentage change in Unemployment Insurance: {pct_change_unemployment:.4f}%")
print()
print(f"Arc Elasticity: {arc_elasticity:.3f}")
EOF

# Data from Treasury Bulletin June 1960, Page 71
# Values in thousands of dollars

Q1 = 4807819  # Total collections
P1 = 26461    # Unemployment insurance

delta_P = P2 - P1

pct_change_P = delta_P / P_mid
